title: Crestline Credit Card Holder Labor Reduction on Alignment Services & Plans Visits
content:
**Crestline Credit Card holders receive a labor reduction on the open work order of an Alignment Services & Plans alignment plan.** A cardholder labor reduction takes a percentage of the pricing base off the labor charged. The percentage is read from the customer's Crestline Credit Card account and the late fees posted to it in the 12 calendar months up to the plan desk's pricing.

| Crestline Credit Card account of the customer | Late fee posted to that account in the 12 calendar months up to the pricing | Cardholder labor reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Active | None | 10% of the pricing base |
| Active | One or more | 5% of the pricing base |
| No active account | — | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the pricing base, and taken off the labor charged; the labor charged never falls below 0.00.

### Basis questions
- *A late fee posted 13 months before the pricing?* It falls outside the 12 calendar months, so an active account with no other late fee in that period takes the 10% reduction.
- *An account that is closed or otherwise not active?* It is not an active account, so the reduction is 0%.

*Hypothetical:* on a pricing base of 40.00, 4.00 is taken off for a customer whose active card account had no late fee in the period, and 2.00 when it had one.
